title: FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation
title_zh: FlockWorld：通过人工生命模拟迈向种群规模多智能体视频世界模型

paragraphs.en: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds’s Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation. † † Codebase, configs, and rollout videos are available at https://github.com/wangyz1999/flockworld
paragraphs.zh: 大多数动作条件化的视频世界模型仍然局限于单个玩家，而现有多玩家模型仅支持规模较小、固定的智能体群体。 我们提出 FlockWorld，一个基于 Reynolds 的 Boids 算法构建的人工生命环境，用于研究群体规模的多智能体视频世界模型。 具体而言，FlockWorld 渲染同步的自我中心视角裁剪画面，为不同相机分配不同颜色以在各视角间保持相机—智能体身份对应，将规则推导出的加速度作为动作，并允许相机智能体的数量独立于周围种群规模进行配置。 我们进一步提出 FlockDiT，一个动作条件化的潜在扩散 Transformer，在 FlockWorld 数据上用流匹配进行训练，从而为多个智能体联合生成同步的自我中心视角视频。 我们的结果表明，联合生成在密度匹配的设置下有利于智能体检测，且扩散强制提升了 rollout 保真度。 总体而言，FlockWorld 与 FlockDiT 为多智能体视频生成提供了一个受控测试平台。† † 代码库、配置和 rollout 视频可在 https://github.com/wangyz1999/flockworld 获取

paragraphs.en: Interactive video world models aim to learn controllable, persistent, and real-time simulators through action-conditioned video generation, with broad applications in interactive environment generation [ 4 ] , real-time neural game engines [ 2 , 48 , 41 ] , robotic control and planning [ 51 , 53 ] , autonomous-driving simulation [ 36 , 27 ] , and generative computer interfaces [ 58 ] . Recent work such as Solaris [ 37 ] , Gamma-World [ 26 ] , and MIRA [ 14 ] has extended this paradigm to multiplayer settings, where generative world models must jointly represent the actions and observations of multiple agents within a shared environment (Appendix A ). However, scaling current multi-agent world models to massive populations and socially aware interactive environments with complex behavior remains underexplored. Achieving this capability could enable persistent virtual societies, population-scale training environments for embodied and social agents, and counterfactual simulations of complex collective systems.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频世界模型旨在通过动作条件化的视频生成学习可控、持久且实时的模拟器，在交互式环境生成 [ 4 ] 、实时神经网络游戏引擎 [ 2 , 48 , 41 ] 、机器人控制与规划 [ 51 , 53 ] 、自动驾驶仿真 [ 36 , 27 ] 以及生成式计算机界面 [ 58 ] 等领域具有广泛的应用。 近期的工作，如 Solaris [ 37 ] 、Gamma-World [ 26 ] 和 MIRA [ 14 ] ，已将这一范式扩展到多玩家设置，其中生成式世界模型必须在共享环境中联合表示多个智能体的动作与观测（附录 A ）。 然而，将现有多智能体世界模型扩展到具有复杂行为的大规模群体和社会感知型交互环境仍待深入探索。 实现这一能力将有望催生持久的虚拟社会、面向具身智能体和社会智能体的群体规模训练环境，以及对复杂集体系统的反事实仿真。

paragraphs.en: To investigate these challenges in a tractable setting, we turn to artificial-life simulation, in which agents act from local observations, influence one another within a shared environment, and produce population-level behavior through repeated interaction. In a flock, each agent’s movement depends on those around it, giving rise to collective behavior. This offers a perspective on agency in which individual behavior and collective dynamics are inseparable, as each agent follows its own trajectory yet remains part of a larger whole. Recent environment-grounded LLM-agent simulations instantiate this structure in richer social settings, showing how shared worlds mediate individual and collective behavior [ 28 , 1 , 45 , 32 ] . In this paper, we study this structure in a controlled visual setting by introducing FlockWorld, a visually grounded multi-agent artificial-life environment for video world modeling built on Reynolds’s Boids algorithm [ 33 ] , in which local inter-agent dynamics are directly reflected in agents’ spatial configurations and trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在一个易于处理的环境中研究这些挑战，我们转向人工生命模拟，其中智能体基于局部观察行动，在共享环境中相互影响，并通过反复交互产生群体层面的行为。 在鸟群中，每个智能体的运动都取决于其周围的智能体，从而产生集体行为。 这提供了一种关于能动性的视角，其中个体行为与集体动态不可分割，因为每个智能体都遵循自身的轨迹，却仍是更大整体的一部分。 近期的基于环境的LLM智能体模拟在更丰富的社会场景中实例化了这种结构，展示了共享世界如何调节个体与集体行为 [ 28 , 1 , 45 , 32 ] 。 在本文中，我们通过引入FlockWorld在一个受控的视觉环境中研究这种结构。FlockWorld是一个基于Reynolds的Boids算法 [ 33 ] 构建的、面向视频世界建模的视觉接地多智能体人工生命环境，其中智能体间的局部动态直接体现在智能体的空间构型与轨迹中。

paragraphs.en: Rule-based and emergent systems are a longstanding subject of generative art, in which the artist specifies a process and the work is produced by its execution [ 7 ] . Flocking is one such system, introduced by Reynolds as a distributed behavioral model. Creative agency is distributed by construction, since a vision radius and three rule weights are specified but no one determines the flock’s shape at any given moment. FlockWorld retains these rules, following the parameterization of an open-source implementation [ 16 ] , and adds a viewpoint, so the same flock can be observed from the perspectives of 2 to 30 of its own members, which we call camera agents, rather than from above. FlockDiT, the world model we introduce below, distributes agency further by giving each camera agent its own action stream, which modulates only that agent’s view. Our two main failure modes are failures of that distribution. Rolling out each view independently invents camera agents the episode never contained, and one of our two conditioning schemes produces ten views that behave as a single scene cut into ten panels rather than ten separate observers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的系统与涌现系统是生成艺术中长期存在的主题：艺术家设定一个过程，而作品通过该过程的执行而产生 [ 7 ] 。 聚集（flocking）就是这样一个系统，由 Reynolds 作为一种分布式行为模型提出。 创造性智能体在结构上就是分布式的：只指定了一个视野半径和三个规则权重，但没有任何人决定聚集群在任一时刻的形状。 FlockWorld 保留了这些规则，遵循一个开源实现的参数化方式 [ 16 ] ，并加入了一个视点，使得同一聚集群可以从其 2 至 30 个成员（我们称之为相机智能体）的视角来观察，而不是从上方俯视。 FlockDiT 是我们在下文介绍的世界模型，它进一步分配了智能体性，为每个相机智能体赋予各自独立的动作流，该动作流只调节该智能体自身的视角。 我们的两种主要失败模式正是这种分配的失败。 独立地逐帧生成每个视角会虚构出该回合从未包含的相机智能体，而且我们的两种条件化方案之一会产生十个视角，它们表现得像一个被切成十块面板的单一场景，而不是十个独立的观察者。

paragraphs.en: FlockWorld supports a configurable population size and a camera-agent count that can be set independently of it. It provides synchronized egocentric observations and acceleration actions for each camera agent (Sec. 2 ). We fix the population at 100 boids and evaluate configurations with 2 to 30 camera agents. We also introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer that jointly generates multiple agents’ views using temporally causal cross-agent attention (Sec. 3 ). We study different schemes for representing agent identity and conditioning on actions, as well as the effects of diffusion forcing, single-agent pretraining, and a position-encoding background.

paragraphs.en: We implement FlockWorld in JAX as an interactive 2D simulation of 100 boids in a 720 × 720 720\times 720 pixel arena, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Boid motion follows three local Reynolds flocking rules [ 33 ] . Alignment encourages neighboring boids to move in similar directions, cohesion draws each boid toward the local flock center, and separation prevents collisions and overcrowding by repelling nearby boids. Each boid responds only to neighbors within a 25-pixel radius. We use reflecting boundaries and randomly initialize each boid’s position, heading, and speed, discarding the first 60 steps as warm-up before rendering at 30 frames per second. Steering constants and the five-point boid geometry follow [ 16 ] . We expose each camera agent’s rule-derived acceleration as its action signal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 JAX 中实现了 FlockWorld，这是一个 720 × 720 像素场地内 100 个 boid 的交互式二维仿真，如图 1 所示。 Boid 的运动遵循三条局部 Reynolds 集群规则 [33]。 对齐促使相邻 boid 朝相似方向移动，聚合将每个 boid 拉向局部集群中心，分离则通过排斥附近的 boid 来防止碰撞和过度拥挤。 每个 boid 仅响应 25 像素半径内的邻居。 我们采用反射边界，并随机初始化每个 boid 的位置、朝向和速度，在以每秒 30 帧渲染之前丢弃前 60 步作为预热。 转向常数和五点的 boid 几何形状遵循 [16]。 我们将每个摄像头智能体由规则导出的加速度作为其动作信号。

paragraphs.en: At each simulation step, we use each camera agent’s acceleration ( a x , a y ) (a_{x},a_{y}) , the net steering signal produced by the alignment, cohesion, and separation rules, as its action. paragraphs.en: We model FlockWorld in a compact latent space using a smaller-capacity version of the Wan 2.2 causal VAE [ 20 , 43 ] . We train a separate VAE from scratch for each visual condition and freeze it before training the world model. The VAE compresses 128 × 128 128\times 128 video by 16 × 16\times spatially and 4 × 4\times temporally into 8 8 -channel 8 × 8 8\times 8 latent frames. The compression is causal, so the first latent frame encodes one video frame and each subsequent frame four. Architecture and training hyperparameters are in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个容量更小的 Wan 2.2 因果 VAE [20, 43] 版本，将 FlockWorld 建模在一个紧凑的潜在空间中。 我们为每种视觉条件从头训练一个单独的 VAE，并在训练世界模型之前将其冻结。 该 VAE 将 128 × 128 128\times 128 的视频在空间上压缩 16 × 16\times 倍、在时间上压缩 4 × 4\times 倍，得到 8 8 通道、8 × 8 8\times 8 的潜在帧。 这种压缩是因果的，因此第一个潜在帧编码一帧视频，而后续每个潜在帧编码四帧。 架构与训练超参数见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: FlockDiT (Fig. 2 ) is a PyTorch adaptation of the Solaris single- and multi-player world model [ 37 ] . We retain its factorized 3D RoPE, AdaLN-zero conditioning, and block-causal attention, while removing image-to-video cross-attention for latent egocentric generation. Our diffusion transformer [ 42 , 29 ] contains 8 blocks, has width 512, and comprises approximately 27.5M parameters. We use a block-causal temporal mask with full cross-agent attention, so a token at timestep t t may attend to all spatial tokens from every agent at timesteps τ ≤ t \tau\leq t but not at future timesteps. This preserves temporal causality while enabling information exchange across agent views. Actions reach the latent timeline by the pooling of Sec. 2.2 .
paragraphs.zh: FlockDiT（图 2 ）是 Solaris 单人与多智能体世界模型 [ 37 ] 的 PyTorch 改编实现。 我们保留了其分解式 3D RoPE、AdaLN-zero 条件机制和块因果注意力，同时移除了图像到视频的交叉注意力，以实现潜空间自我中心生成。 我们的扩散 Transformer [ 42 , 29 ] 包含 8 个块，宽度为 512，参数量约为 27.5M。 我们使用带有完整跨智能体注意力的块因果时间掩码，因此时间步 t t 上的标记可以关注每个智能体在时间步 τ ≤ t \tau\leq t 的所有空间标记，但不能关注未来时间步的标记。 这在保持时间因果性的同时，实现了跨智能体视野之间的信息交换。 动作通过 Sec. 2.2 的池化方式进入潜空间时间线。

paragraphs.en: All views use the same local spatial coordinates, and a learned agent embedding is added to each view’s tokens. Each agent’s acceleration modulates only its own tokens through AdaLN, making both agent identity and action assignment explicit.

paragraphs.en: Following MIRA [ 14 ] , we assign the latent token grids of the P P views to non-overlapping regions of a shared spatial RoPE grid [ 38 ] . For P = 10 P=10 , the views form a 2 × 5 2\times 5 layout. This tiles token coordinates rather than input pixels. Tile-specific RoPE positions provide implicit agent identity, so we disable the additive agent embeddings. To condition on actions, we add a learned agent tag to each encoded acceleration, mean-pool the tagged actions, and broadcast the resulting vector to all tokens through AdaLN. The model must therefore infer which component of the pooled action signal applies to each tile.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 MIRA [ 14 ]，我们将 P P 个视角的潜词元网格分配到一个共享空间 RoPE 网格 [ 38 ] 中互不重叠的区域。 当 P = 10 P=10 时，各视角构成 2 × 5 2\times 5 的布局。 这种方式划分的是词元坐标而非输入像素。 各分块特有的 RoPE 位置隐式地提供了智能体身份信息，因此我们禁用了附加的智能体嵌入。 为了以动作为条件，我们在每个编码后的加速度上添加一个可学习的智能体标签，对带标签的动作进行均值池化，并通过 AdaLN 将得到的向量广播到所有词元。 因此，模型必须推断池化后的动作信号中哪个分量适用于每个分块。

paragraphs.en: By default we train with teacher forcing, in which the context frames remain clean and noise is applied only to the target frames. We additionally evaluate diffusion forcing [ 5 ] , in which every frame, including the context frames, is assigned an independent random noise level and contributes to the training loss. This exposes the model to corrupted context during training, matching the imperfect context it encounters during autoregressive rollout. Noise levels are drawn independently per frame and, in the embedded configuration, per agent. In the tiled configuration, all P P views of a frame are denoised jointly and therefore share one level [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，我们使用教师强制（teacher forcing）进行训练，其中上下文帧保持干净，噪声仅施加于目标帧。 我们还评估了扩散强制（diffusion forcing）[ 5 ]，其中每一帧（包括上下文帧）都被分配一个独立的随机噪声水平，并参与训练损失的 计算。 这使模型在训练期间接触到被破坏的上下文，与它在自回归推理（rollout）时遇到的不完美上下文相匹配。 噪声水平按帧独立抽取，并且在嵌入式配置下按智能体独立抽取。 在平铺配置下，一帧的全部 P P 个视图被联合去噪，因此共享同一个噪声水平 [ 14 ]。

paragraphs.en: Modeling P P views jointly is a harder optimization problem than modeling one. We therefore pretrain the world model in a single-agent setting and initialize the multi-agent model from that checkpoint, then train on clips containing all P P agents, so the model learns the visual dynamics before adapting to multi-agent interactions [ 14 ] .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each model on 28 held-out episodes. For each episode, we initialize the model with two ground-truth latent frames and autoregressively generate a 10-second rollout from the recorded actions, using a 50-step Euler solver per prediction window (Appendix J ). We decode generated latents to pixels and evaluate both per-view fidelity to the recorded trajectory and cross-view consistency among generated views.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在28个留出片段上评估每个模型。 对于每个片段，我们用两个真实潜在帧初始化模型，并根据录制的动作自回归地生成10秒的展开，每个预测窗口使用50步欧拉求解器（附录 J）。 我们将生成的潜在表示解码为像素，并评估其相对录制轨迹的每视角保真度以及生成视角之间的跨视角一致性。

sents.zh: 我们在28个留出片段上评估每个模型。

sents.en: For each episode, we initialize the model with two ground-truth latent frames and autoregressively generate a 10-second rollout from the recorded actions, using a 50-step Euler solver per prediction window (Appendix J ).
sents.zh: 对于每个片段，我们用两个真实潜在帧初始化模型，并根据录制的动作自回归地生成10秒的展开，每个预测窗口使用50步欧拉求解器（附录 J）。

sents.en: We decode generated latents to pixels and evaluate both per-view fidelity to the recorded trajectory and cross-view consistency among generated views.
sents.zh: 我们将生成的潜在表示解码为像素，并评估其相对录制轨迹的每视角保真度以及生成视角之间的跨视角一致性。

paragraphs.en: For each view, the detection rate is the fraction of ground-truth visible boids matched by a detection, the position error is the pixel distance between matched detections and their ground-truth positions, and detections per frame is the predicted number of visible boids, compared with the ground-truth count.

paragraphs.en: The seven configurations are the embedded baseline (Exp. 1), tiling (2), diffusion forcing (3), two-stage training (4), and tiling with diffusion forcing (5), both (6), or two-stage training (7).

paragraphs.en: Detection density strongly confounds cross-view consistency metrics (Table 1 ). Experiment 2 achieves high reciprocity but renders 23.14 detections per frame against 5.04 in the ground truth, and its displacement error is close to the floor’s, so raw reciprocity can reward over-rendering rather than agreement. Experiment 3, with diffusion forcing, matches the ground-truth density more closely and gives the strongest overall fidelity among the learned models at a usable detection rate, while Experiment 5 matches it on pixel and motion measures but detects half as many boids. Motion error, which tests the frame-to-frame change in relative offset and so removes static bias, cleanly separates the diffusion-forcing runs from the teacher-forced runs and the floor. Tiling alone worsens over-rendering, and adding two-stage training recovers its density calibration but not its detection rate. Overall, diffusion forcing is the most effective intervention tested.
paragraphs.zh: 检测密度强烈干扰跨视角一致性指标（表 1）。 实验 2 达到了较高的互惠性，但每帧产生 23.14 个检测，而真值仅为 5.04，且其位移误差接近地板块的水平，因此原始互惠性可能奖励的是过度渲染而非一致。 采用扩散强制的实验 3 更接近真值密度，在可用检测率下取得了学习模型中最强的整体保真度，而实验 5 在像素与运动指标上与其相当，但检测到的 boids 数量只有其一半。 运动误差衡量相邻帧之间相对偏移的变化，因此消除了静态偏差，能清晰地将扩散强制运行与教师强制运行及地板块区分开。 仅用分块会加剧过度渲染，加入两阶段训练能恢复其密度校准，但无法恢复其检测率。 总体而言，扩散强制是所测试的最有效干预手段。

paragraphs.en: We inspect rollouts (Fig. 4 , Appendix L ) for simulator-faithful behavior that aggregate metrics miss, namely focal-agent centering, color preservation, boundary dynamics, and whether the P P outputs are distinct views of the arena. Experiments 1, 3, 4, and 6 preserve centering, whereas 2, 5, 7, and the floor do not. Experiment 5 also loses agent color, explaining its low hue-based sighting count, and over-rendering appears as dense fields of spurious colored boids. In Experiments 5 and 7, boids often move continuously between adjacent tiles, making the 2 × 5 2\times 5 output resemble a partitioned panorama rather than ten independently conditioned viewpoints. Our budget-fixed reimplementation cannot establish that tiling causes this, but the failure shows that aggregate consistency metrics can reward coherent outputs built from an incorrect multi-view geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查了 rollout（图 4、附录 L），以发现聚合指标会遗漏的对模拟器的忠实行为，即焦点智能体的居中性、颜色保持性、边界动态，以及 P P 输出是否为竞技场的不同视角。 实验 1、3、4 和 6 保持了居中性，而实验 2、5、7 以及 floor 则没有。 实验 5 还丢失了智能体的颜色，这解释了其基于色调的目击计数偏低的原因，而过渲染则表现为大片密集的虚假彩色 boid。 在实验 5 和 7 中，boid 常常在相邻瓦片之间连续移动，使得 2 × 5 2\times 5 的输出更像是一幅被分割的全景图，而不是十个独立条件下的视角。 我们的固定预算复现无法证明平铺是造成这一问题的原因，但该失败表明，聚合一致性指标可能会奖励那些基于错误多视角几何构建的看似连贯的输出。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the advantage of joint multi-view training persists as coordination scales, we sweep P P from 2 to 30 under a fixed wall-clock budget against the single-agent floor (Table 2 ). Our model achieves a higher detection rate at every P P , although results at P = 5 P=5 , 8 8 , and 20 20 are confounded by its roughly 2.5 × 2.5\times higher detection density, and the margin at P = 2 P=2 ( 22.7 22.7 against 20.1 20.1 ) falls inside the episode-level spread. The strongest evidence therefore comes from the density-matched P = 10 P=10 and P = 30 P=30 , where our model detects more agents at essentially the floor’s detection density. It persists despite larger settings receiving less optimization (18 epochs at P = 30 P=30 against 170 at P = 5 P=5 ). We do not infer a scaling trend from reciprocity, since its ceiling varies non-monotonically with P P , so each P P is compared only with its own references (Appendix O ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验联合多视角训练的优势是否随协同规模扩大而持续存在，我们在固定时钟时间预算下将 P P 从 2 扫描到 30，并与单智能体基线进行比较（表 2 ）。 我们的模型在每个 P P 下都取得了更高的检出率，尽管 P = 5 P=5 、8 8 和 20 20 时的结果因其约 2.5 × 2.5\times 更高的检出密度而受到混淆，且 P = 2 P=2 时的差距（22.7 22.7 对 20.1 20.1）落在回合层面的波动范围内。 因此，最有力的证据来自密度匹配的 P = 10 P=10 和 P = 30 P=30 ，在这两处我们的模型在基本相同的检出密度下检出了更多智能体。 尽管更大的设置获得的优化更少（P = 30 P=30 时为 18 个 epoch，而 P = 5 P=5 时为 170 个），该优势依然存在。 我们不基于互惠性推断扩展趋势，因为其上限随 P P 非单调变化，因此每个 P P 只与其自身的参照进行比较（附录 O ）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced FlockWorld, an environment for population-scale multi-agent video world modeling, and FlockDiT, which generates many agents’ egocentric views jointly. Joint generation reproduces more of the agents present than independent generation, an advantage that persists as camera agents are added, and diffusion forcing is the most effective training strategy we tested. Consistency metrics are confounded by rendered density and should be judged against matched references. Scaling further will require sparser cross-agent attention, such as over local neighborhoods.

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned video generation has emerged as a way to build interactive simulators. These models build on latent diffusion [ 34 ] and diffusion transformers [ 29 ] trained with flow matching [ 25 ] , and have been adapted into visual simulators beyond latent dynamics models for control [ 52 , 3 , 24 ] . Applications include video games, where models generate playable frames from controller input [ 4 , 9 , 10 , 41 , 2 , 6 , 11 , 56 , 12 , 48 , 22 ] , autonomous driving [ 13 , 36 , 27 ] , robotic control and planning [ 51 , 23 , 8 , 53 ] , and generative computer interfaces [ 58 ] . Autoregressive rollout creates a train-test mismatch, since the model trains on clean context but generates from its own outputs. Diffusion forcing assigns each frame an independent noise level [ 5 ] , while causal distillation and self-forcing supervise the model on its own generations [ 54 , 17 ] . Such models could underpin generative game engines that respond to player actions [ 55 ] , but they condition on a single action stream, from one player or camera, and do not keep multiple simultaneous observers of one world consistent.

paragraphs.en: Modeling a world that several agents reshape at once is more recent. The World and Human Action Model is trained on four-versus-four gameplay but conditions on one player’s controls, treating the others as environment [ 18 ] , and Multiverse simulates two-player racing by concatenating the players’ frames channel-wise [ 40 ] . Newer models condition on several agents at once. Some model two players, or per-agent first-person views beyond two players, in Minecraft [ 37 , 26 ] . paragraphs.en: Such models need synchronized first-person views of several agents, which mostly must be collected. Real-world multi-egocentric datasets require people wearing cameras, as in EgoHumans, with several Aria wearers during sports and games [ 19 ] , and CASTLE 2024, with ten wearers over four days of shared living [ 35 ] . Multiplayer gameplay must likewise be recorded. X-Ego-CS replays public Counter-Strike 2 matches to capture all ten players’ views and inputs [ 44 ] , GameplayQA manually aligns streamers’ recordings of shared matches for multi-video question answering [ 46 ] , and MultiWorld records hundreds of hours of human two-player play [ 49 ] . sents.zh: 该环境完全是合成的，不包含任何人类数据。

paragraphs.en: The environment is a 720 × 720 720\times 720 pixel arena containing 100 boids that follow the three steering rules of Reynolds [ 33 ] , namely alignment, cohesion, and separation. These rules are computed over neighbors within a 25-pixel vision radius and weighted by 1.1 1.1 , 1.0 1.0 , and 1.5 1.5 , respectively. Following the reference implementation [ 16 ] , the alignment rule additionally weights each neighbor by 1.5 ⟨ v i , v j ⟩ 1.5^{\langle v_{i},v_{j}\rangle} , favoring neighbors heading in a similar direction. When more than 32 candidate neighbors are available, each is retained independently with probability 32 / N 32/N , where N N is the number of candidates, so roughly 32 neighbors are expected to contribute. Each rule is implemented as a Reynolds-style steering force, in which the desired velocity is set to the maximum speed and the current velocity is subtracted. The resulting net steering force is clamped to a maximum magnitude of 0.2 0.2 per step, boid speeds are clamped to [ 1 , 4 ] [1,4] pixels per step, and a velocity drag of 0.005 0.005 per step is applied.
paragraphs.zh: 环境是一个 720 × 720 720\times 720 像素的场地，其中包含 100 个遵循 Reynolds [ 33 ] 三条转向规则的 boids，即对齐、聚集和分离。 这些规则在视野半径为 25 像素内的邻居上计算，并分别以 1.1 1.1 、1.0 1.0 和 1.5 1.5 加权。 参照参考实现 [ 16 ]，对齐规则额外以 1.5 ⟨ v i , v j ⟩ 1.5^{\langle v_{i},v_{j}\rangle} 对每个邻居加权，偏向朝相似方向前进的邻居。 当候选邻居超过 32 个时，每个候选者以 32 / N 32/N 的概率被独立保留，其中 N N 是候选者数量，因此预期大约有 32 个邻居参与贡献。 每条规则都实现为 Reynolds 风格的转向力，其中期望速度被设为最大速度，并减去当前速度。 所得的净转向力每步被限制在最大幅值 0.2 0.2 以内，boid 的速度被限制在每步 [ 1 , 4 ] [1,4] 像素之间，并且每步施加 0.005 0.005 的速度阻力。

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of each episode, positions are sampled uniformly within the arena, inset by 7 pixels from the walls, headings uniformly from [ − π , π ] [-\pi,\pi] , and speeds uniformly from the allowed range. Our JAX simulator is a reimplementation of the interactive flocking simulation from [ 16 ] , matching its steering rules, parameter defaults, and boid geometry.

paragraphs.en: Training data is generated on the fly because the simulator is fast. Each training clip is a freshly simulated 21-frame ( 0.7 0.7 s) segment, corresponding to six latent frames under the causal 1 + 4 ​ k 1+4k temporal compression described in Appendix E . Clips are generated during data loading and encoded to latents on the GPU. Each simulated episode is cut into several consecutive windows (four during multi-agent training and sixteen during single-agent pretraining), so one simulation supplies several temporally adjacent clips. This amortizes the cost of simulating an episode, at the price of some correlation among the clips drawn from it. However, because every episode is simulated fresh, the model never revisits a clip and the effective training set is not fixed. The number of unique training clips is limited primarily by the available training budget. For evaluation, we use a fixed held-out set of recorded 30-second episodes, each containing 900 frames and P P synchronized views. The evaluation episodes are generated from seeds that are disjoint from those used during training.
paragraphs.zh: 由于模拟器速度很快，训练数据是在运行时即时生成的。 每个训练片段都是全新模拟的21帧（0.7 0.7 秒）片段，对应于附录E中描述的因果性 1 + 4 ​ k 1+4k 时间压缩下的六个隐层帧。 片段在数据加载期间生成，并在GPU上编码为隐层表示。 每个模拟回合被切分为若干连续窗口（多智能体训练时为四个，单智能体预训练时为十六个），因此一次模拟可以提供多个时间上相邻的片段。 这摊薄了模拟一个回合的成本，代价是来自同一回合的片段之间存在一定的相关性。 然而，由于每个回合都是全新模拟的，模型不会重复访问同一片段，有效训练集也不是固定的。 唯一训练片段的数量主要受可用训练预算的限制。 在评估方面，我们使用一个固定的留出集，其中包含录制的30秒回合，每个回合包含900帧和 P P 个同步视角。 评估回合使用的种子与训练中使用的种子互不相交。

paragraphs.en: A central question in this work is whether the views of an episode can be made mutually consistent, which requires the model to infer the relationships among the camera agents. Boids in the base simulation are identical and white, so a crop of the arena is anonymous. Aside from the arena boundary, it carries no explicit information about its absolute location or about which agent is being observed. We therefore give each camera agent its own hue, spaced evenly around the color wheel at intervals of 1 / P 1/P , while the non-camera boids stay white. Agent color also enables our ground-truth-free consistency metrics (Appendix J ), which identify camera agents in one another’s views by hue. Note that the palette tightens as P P grows, so hue identification becomes harder at large P P even for ground-truth decodes.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的一个核心问题是，能否让一段情节的各个视角相互一致，这要求模型推断各相机智能体之间的关系。 基础仿真中的 boids 是完全相同且为白色的，因此竞技场的一个裁剪区域是匿名的。 除竞技场边界外，它不携带任何关于其绝对位置或关于正在观测哪个智能体的显式信息。 因此，我们为每个相机智能体赋予各自的色调，在色轮上以 1 / P 1/P 的间隔均匀分布，而非相机的 boids 则保持白色。 智能体颜色还使我们无需真值的一致性指标（附录 J）成为可能，该指标通过色调在各相机智能体的彼此视角中识别它们。 请注意，调色板会随着 P P 的增大而变紧，因此即使对于真值解码，在较大的 P P 下通过色调进行识别也变得更加困难。

paragraphs.en: The two world models share an architecture and receive nearly the same optimization budget, 393k against 394k steps, so the comparison of Sec. 5.4 is budget-matched at the level of the world model but not below it, since the black-background autoencoder was trained for roughly 115k steps on a fixed recorded dataset, whereas the gradient-background autoencoder was trained for roughly 887k steps on streamed clips (Appendix E ). Because every ceiling is a decode through the condition’s own autoencoder passed through the hue-based detector, autoencoder quality sets the ceiling directly, and the gradient condition’s higher and more stable reciprocity ceiling cannot be attributed to its background representation in isolation. paragraphs.en: We train two autoencoders (one per visual condition) from scratch at reduced capacity rather than using released pretrained weights, since the encoder has to model its condition’s appearance. Both use an L 1 L_{1} reconstruction loss and a KL penalty with weight 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and neither uses a perceptual or adversarial loss, because the rendered environment is simple enough for L 1 L_{1} reconstruction to recover the visual details sharply. Both are trained on 17-frame clips, a different length from the 21-frame clips used later to train the world model, and both lengths satisfy the 1 + 4 ​ k 1+4k requirement of the causal temporal compression, giving five and six latent frames respectively. The black-background autoencoder reaches its best validation loss of 0.0042 0.0042 at epoch 81 of 100 (115,292 optimizer steps) on a fixed dataset of recorded episodes, while the gradient-background autoencoder reaches 0.0046 0.0046 after roughly 887k steps on streamed clips, so the two autoencoders differ in training length and data source even though they share an architecture and optimizer. After training each autoencoder is frozen, so the world model trains and rolls out entirely in latent space, using the posterior mean as a deterministic latent encoding. Full VAE hyperparameters are provided in Table 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从头开始以较小的容量训练两个自编码器（每种视觉条件各一个），而不是使用已发布的预训练权重，因为编码器必须对其所处条件的外观进行建模。 两者均使用 L 1 L_{1} 重建损失和权重为 10 − 6 10^{-6} 的 KL 惩罚项，且都不使用感知损失或对抗损失，因为渲染的环境足够简单，L 1 L_{1} 重建就能清晰地恢复视觉细节。 两者都在 17 帧的片段上训练，其长度与之后用于训练世界模型的 21 帧片段不同，且这两个长度都满足因果时序压缩的 1 + 4 ​ k 1+4k 要求，分别对应五个和六个潜在帧。 黑色背景自编码器在 100 个 epoch（115,292 次优化器步数）中，于第 81 个 epoch 在固定录制回合数据集上达到 0.0042 0.0042 的最佳验证损失；而渐变背景自编码器在流式片段上经过约 887k 步后达到 0.0046 0.0046，因此尽管两个自编码器共享相同的架构和优化器，但它们的训练时长和数据来源有所不同。 每个自编码器在训练后被冻结，因此世界模型完全在潜在空间中进行训练和展开，并使用后验均值作为确定性的潜在编码。 完整的 VAE 超参数见表 6。

paragraphs.en: The model is conditioned through adaptive layer normalization with zero initialization (AdaLN-zero) [ 29 ] . At each step, a conditioning vector c c is formed by combining a sinusoidal embedding of the noise level σ \sigma with an embedding of the actions, with each embedding passed through a small MLP. For each transformer block, a linear projection maps c c to six modulation parameters, namely a shift, scale, and gate for the attention sublayer and the same three quantities for the feed-forward sublayer. These parameters are initialized so that the modulation initially acts as the identity. The conditioning is defined per latent frame and per agent and is broadcast over the 64 spatial tokens belonging to that frame. Thus, each action can condition every spatial token of its corresponding latent frame while remaining causal in time. The way the P P agents’ actions are combined depends on the multi-agent conditioning scheme described next.

paragraphs.en: This section records the implementation details of the two conditioning schemes described in the main text. The embedded scheme follows Solaris [ 37 ] , using learned embeddings to distinguish agents whose views share the same spatial RoPE coordinates. The tiled scheme follows MIRA [ 14 ] , using a broadcast action vector with learned per-agent tags to associate actions with their corresponding view tiles. The tiled scheme also uses MIRA’s warm-start curriculum.
paragraphs.zh: 本节记录正文中所述两种条件化方案的实现细节。 嵌入式方案遵循 Solaris [37]，使用学习到的嵌入来区分视角共享相同空间 RoPE 坐标的智能体。 平铺式方案遵循 MIRA [14]，使用带学习的每智能体标签的广播动作向量，将动作与其对应的视角平铺块相关联。 平铺式方案还使用了 MIRA 的热启动课程。

paragraphs.en: Each model is evaluated on 28 held-out episodes. Given the first two latent frames of all P P views as context, the model generates a 10-second autoregressive rollout using 50 Euler steps per prediction window while replaying the agents’ recorded actions. A 10-second rollout corresponds to 75 latent frames, which decode to 297 video frames under the causal 1 + 4 ​ k 1+4k compression. The predicted latents are decoded to pixels before metric computation. Because the model replays the actions from the recorded episode, a perfect prediction would reproduce the ground-truth trajectory. In practice, generated rollouts can diverge from the reference. Our metrics therefore distinguish errors relative to the ground truth, which are expected in generative models, from inconsistencies between views of the same scene, which indicate a failure of cross-view consistency.

paragraphs.en: We use two reference rows to help interpret the evaluation metrics. The ceiling decodes the ground-truth latents through the same frozen VAE and applies the identical detector and metrics. It therefore represents the best performance achievable within the latent representation and detection pipeline. It is below perfect performance because detector and hue-identification errors can reduce the measured scores. The floor rolls out each view independently using a single-agent model, so the P P views are generated without any shared information. It therefore measures the level of cross-view agreement obtainable without joint modeling. Some agreement is still expected because all views start from the same ground-truth context and are generated under the same simulation conditions. Improvement over this floor indicates that jointly modeling the views improves cross-view consistency compared with generating each view independently. Both references use the same episodes, evaluation protocol, and detector as the models under test. The gradient-background run has a ceiling but no floor, since no single-agent model was trained under that rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两个参考行来帮助解读评估指标。 上限通过同一个冻结的 VAE 对真实潜在变量进行解码，并应用相同的检测器与指标。 因此它代表了在潜在表示与检测流程内可达到的最佳性能。 它低于完美性能，因为检测器与色相识别错误可能降低测得的分数。 下限使用单智能体模型对每个视角独立地进行 rollout，因此 P P 个视角的生成不共享任何信息。 因此它衡量的是在不进行联合建模的情况下可获得的跨视角一致性水平。 仍然可以预期存在一定的一致性，因为所有视角都从相同的真实上下文出发，并在相同的仿真条件下生成。 相对于该下限的提升表明，对各视角进行联合建模与独立生成每个视角相比能够改善跨视角一致性。 两个参考都使用与被测模型相同的回合、评估协议和检测器。 渐变背景的运行有上限但没有下限，因为没有单智能体模型在该渲染下进行过训练。

paragraphs.en: The examples illustrate the distinction measured by our evaluation metrics. The floor, which does not jointly model the camera agents, generates colored boids that are not present in the episode and does not reliably preserve the focal agent’s identity. It therefore produces many independent sightings without corresponding spatial agreement across views. The diffusion-forcing model instead preserves the focal agent’s identity and renders most neighboring boids as white, anonymous agents. It makes fewer claims about the locations of other camera agents, but the claims it does make are substantially more consistent across views. Both generated models accumulate visual artifacts over the rollout, including softer boids and small ring-like artifacts. These artifacts illustrate the accumulation of errors when the model relies entirely on its own generated frames as context.
paragraphs.zh: 这些示例说明了我们的评估指标所衡量的区别。 地面模型没有对相机智能体进行联合建模，会生成在该回合中并不存在的彩色仿鸟群个体，也无法可靠地保持焦点智能体的身份。 因此，它产生了大量独立的目击记录，而这些记录在各视角之间没有对应的空间一致性。 扩散强制模型则能保持焦点智能体的身份，并将大多数相邻的仿鸟群个体渲染为白色的匿名智能体。 它对其他相机智能体位置做出的判断较少，但它所做出的判断在各视角之间要一致得多。 两种生成的模型在滚动生成过程中都会累积视觉伪影，包括变得更模糊的仿鸟群个体以及小的环状伪影。 这些伪影说明了当模型完全依赖其自身生成的帧作为上下文时误差的累积。

paragraphs.en: Each run is bounded by wall clock rather than by a fixed epoch count. This implements the fixed-budget protocol of Appendix H . Training is capped at 2,860 minutes, and two-stage runs divide that cap into 710 minutes of single-agent pretraining followed by 2,150 minutes of multi-agent training. Checkpoints are written every 1000 steps so that a run stopped at the cap retains its final state. Stage 2 loads the single-agent weights through train.warm_start , while multi-agent-specific parameters are initialized from scratch and the optimizer is reset. For runs combining diffusion forcing with two-stage training, diffusion forcing is enabled during both stages so that the two stages share one objective.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行受限于墙钟时间，而不是固定的轮次数量。 这实现了附录 H 中的固定预算协议。 训练上限为 2,860 分钟，两阶段运行将该上限划分为 710 分钟的单智能体预训练，随后是 2,150 分钟的多智能体训练。 检查点每 1000 步写入一次，以便在达到上限时停止的运行保留其最终状态。 第二阶段通过 train.warm_start 加载单智能体权重，而多智能体特有的参数则从头初始化，并且优化器被重置。 对于将扩散强迫与两阶段训练相结合的运行，两个阶段都启用扩散强迫，以便两个阶段共享同一个目标函数。

paragraphs.en: Action-state consistency. In our flocking environment, an agent’s acceleration is determined by the state of its neighboring boids. We record these accelerations from the simulation and replay them during rollout. As FlockWorld generates a flock that diverges from the ground-truth trajectory, the neighboring boids around the focal agent may also differ from those in the original simulation. The replayed acceleration is therefore computed from a neighborhood that may differ from the one in the generated frames. This does not conflict with our goal of generating diverse, mutually consistent flock realizations, since we do not require the generated trajectory to match the ground truth. However, the replayed action may become inconsistent with the generated flock as the rollout progresses. Future work could address this limitation by closing the action-state loop and recomputing each agent’s acceleration from the generated multi-agent state during rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 动作-状态一致性。 在我们的群集环境中，智能体的加速度由其邻近 boids 的状态决定。 我们从仿真中记录这些加速度，并在 rollout 期间进行重放。 由于 FlockWorld 生成的鸟群会偏离真值轨迹，焦点智能体周围的邻近 boids 也可能与原始仿真中的不同。 因此，重放的加速度是根据一个可能与生成帧中的邻域不同的邻域计算得到的。 这与我们生成多样化且相互一致的鸟群实现的目标并不冲突，因为我们不要求生成的轨迹与真值匹配。 然而，随着 rollout 的推进，重放的动作可能与生成的鸟群变得不一致。 未来的工作可以通过闭合动作-状态回路，在 rollout 期间根据生成的多智能体状态重新计算每个智能体的加速度来解决这一局限。

paragraphs.en: The measurement ceiling depends on P P , and not monotonically. The measurement ceiling varies with the number of agents, P P , for two different reasons. At large P P , the agent palette uses hues spaced 1 / P 1/P apart, making them harder to distinguish as the palette becomes more crowded. paragraphs.en: Increasing the number of agents from 10 to 30 raises the sequence length from 3,840 to 11,520 tokens and increases the per-timestep attention cost by roughly a factor of nine, assuming the same model width and batch size. Thus, although the simulator itself can efficiently support hundreds of boids, the dense cross-agent attention used by FlockDiT becomes a major scaling bottleneck. paragraphs.en: The main positive impact of this work is accessibility. FlockWorld provides a procedural environment for studying multi-agent world models without proprietary data or large-scale compute. The experiments use a 27.5M-parameter model and run on a single GPU for 48 hours. Together with the released code and configurations, this makes multi-agent modeling accessible to small research groups and undergraduate researchers. The simulator can also be varied in the number of camera agents, visual representation, and interaction radius.

paragraphs.en: https://github.com/solaris-wm/solaris , commit 68e0ed3 . Our flow-matching transformer is a PyTorch reimplementation of a model originally written in JAX/Flax-nnx. We retain its factorized 3D RoPE split, RMS normalization, sinusoidal timestep embedding, AdaLN-zero DiT block with six modulation parameters, block-causal attention, patchify/unpatchify Conv3d scheme, and per-frame token interleaving across agents. We remove the CLIP image-to-video cross-attention and replace the mouse/keyboard action module with a two-dimensional steering acceleration injected through AdaLN. Tiled RoPE, broadcast action conditioning, per-agent action tags, and optional per-layer agent embeddings are additions introduced in our implementation. Our flow-matching code reimplements the rectified-flow forward process, velocity target, and [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] timestep range, and adds per-frame diffusion-forcing timesteps and a context-preserving Euler sampler.
paragraphs.zh: https://github.com/solaris-wm/solaris ，提交号 68e0ed3 。 我们的流匹配变换器是对一个最初用 JAX/Flax-nnx 编写的模型的 PyTorch 重新实现。 我们保留了其分解式 3D RoPE 划分、RMS 归一化、正弦时间步嵌入、带六个调制参数的 AdaLN-zero DiT 块、块状因果注意力、patchify/unpatchify Conv3d 方案，以及跨智能体的逐帧 token 交错。 我们移除了 CLIP 图像到视频的交叉注意力，并用通过 AdaLN 注入的二维转向加速度替换了鼠标/键盘动作模块。 分块 RoPE、广播式动作条件、逐智能体动作标签，以及可选的逐层智能体嵌入，是我们实现中新增的内容。 我们的流匹配代码重新实现了整流流前向过程、速度目标，以及 [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] 时间步范围，并添加了逐帧扩散强迫时间步和保留上下文的 Euler 采样器。
